newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's CNMV suspends Asturiana de Zinc trade.
newsitem.headline: Spain's CNMV suspends Asturiana de Zinc trade.

text.p: Spain's national stock market commission (CNMV) said on Monday it had suspended trade in Asturiana de Zinc after receiving a bid offer for the zinc producer's shares.

"(The CNMV) has suspended as a cautionary measure trade on the bourse in Asturiana de Zinc as a result of the request for a takeover bid on the shares of the cited company," the CNMV said in a statement.
The zinc producer joined Spain's Ibex-35 index of leading shares on July 1. Asturiana de Zinc shares closed down 115 pesetas, 3.67 percent, at 3,015 on Monday.
